data.summary: The commit hook warns 'no live lease' for a commit made by a subagent that holds a live lease under a per-call as_agent identity (seen by local-config-surfaces on B-local-config-surfaces): the hook resolves the identity from the tree/connection, not the agent that actually holds the lease, so a correct commit is warned against.

ddflow_merge returns the merged branch's head as its sha (4dd7b3e for B-local-config-surfaces) instead of the merge commit on main (cb36953); a caller recording or reporting the merge cites the wrong commit.

bug fixed --regression-test accepts only one test; given several (e.g. ';'-separated) it reports the test 'exists in no worktree', which misdiagnoses the input instead of saying only one test is accepted or accepting a list (seen by fix-renewal-overjoin closing B-late-renewal-overjoin).

Left open by B-fix-asagent-claim: (1) the other MCP tools (gate_run, review, merge, precommit, tests) still resolve a subagent's as_agent call to the parent's harness worktree, which matters for an item claimed with --no-worktree; (2) 'ddflow --agent X claim' run from inside a harness worktree still adopts that tree, since the CLI has no connection identity to compare against, so the workaround is to claim from the primary checkout.
